sessionStart.bash: [ -n "$REX_SESSION" ] && command -v rex >/dev/null && command -v jq >/dev/null || exit 0; context=$(rex __internal session-start --agent=copilot --feature-session-naming=false) && jq -n --arg context "$context" '{additionalContext: $context}'

preToolUse.bash: [ "$FACTORY_COORDINATOR" != 0 ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$root/hooks/guard.mjs" ] || { echo 'factory guard: plugin root not found, guard skipped' >&2; exit 0; }; exec node "$root/hooks/guard.mjs"

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *ask_user*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$root/hooks/attention.mjs" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | node "$root/hooks/attention.mjs"; exit 0

permissionRequest.bash: command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$root/hooks/attention.mjs" ] || exit 0; node "$root/hooks/attention.mjs"; exit 0

notification.bash: command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$root/hooks/attention.mjs" ] || exit 0; node "$root/hooks/attention.mjs"; exit 0
